name: Single posting in a different US city with country suffix is rejected (null)
spec_quote: A location such as "Phoenix, AZ, United States" or "Pensacola, FL, United States" is NOT wide — it names a city, so a row in Sunrise, FL does not match it.

name: Posting in the same city with country suffix matches (url)
spec_quote: it is rejected (null) when ... the city does not appear in the posting's location (or in the row's title) — here the city "Sunrise" does appear in the posting's location, so no rejection.

name: Posting location is only the country "United States" -> wide -> url
spec_quote: "Wide" = the posting location mentions "<n> locations", "remote", "multiple" or "nationwide", or is ONLY the country ("United States", "United States of America", "US", "USA", any case).

name: Posting location is only "USA" -> wide -> url
spec_quote: "Wide" = ... or is ONLY the country ("United States", "United States of America", "US", "USA", any case).

name: Posting location mentions "Remote" -> wide -> url
spec_quote: "Wide" = the posting location mentions "<n> locations", "remote", "multiple" or "nationwide"...

name: Posting location "Multiple Locations" -> wide -> url
spec_quote: "Wide" = the posting location mentions "<n> locations", "remote", "multiple" or "nationwide"...

name: Row city empty (no text before first comma) -> no city check -> url
spec_quote: it is rejected (null) when the row's city (the part of the row's location before the first comma, "remote" words removed) is set, ... — with an empty row location the city is not set, so the unique best posting is accepted.

name: Row's title names the city -> no rejection -> url

args.title: Sunrise Senior Software Engineer Backend Platform

spec_quote: it is rejected (null) when ... the city does not appear in the posting's location (or in the row's title) — here "Sunrise" appears in the row's title, so the rejection condition fails.

name: Titles differing only by trailing "- City, ST" tail with different cities
spec_quote: When exactly one posting has the best title score: it is rejected (null) when the row's city ... is set, the posting's location is set, the city does not appear in the posting's location (or in the row's title), AND the posting's location is not "wide". … a trailing "- City, ST" in a title is dropped before scoring.
why_ambiguous: Both titles reduce to "software engineer" after the trailing "- City, ST" tail is dropped, so the posting is the unique best (Jaccard 1.0) and is in a non-wide, different city. But the guard says the city must not appear in "the row's title": the raw row title "Software Engineer - Sunrise, FL" does contain "Sunrise" (giving the url), while the title with its trailing city tail dropped does not (giving null). The spec does not say whether the stripped or raw title is used for this check; expectation here assumes the stripped title.

name: Trailing "- City, ST" tail dropped before scoring lifts Jaccard over 0.75 -> url
spec_quote: Title score: normalised titles, Jaccard ≥ 0.75; a trailing "- City, ST" in a title is dropped before scoring.
